wiki_catalogs.name: Getting Started
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive getting started content for TransitGuide, a step-by-step navigation app for first-time long-distance public transport commuters in South Africa. Explain the project's purpose of transforming uncertain trips into predictable journeys by providing detailed guidance on ranks (bus terminals/taxi stands), costs, visual landmarks, and multi-criteria route options. Document prerequisites including Node.js 20+, npm 10+, Python 3.11+, Android Studio with JDK 17, and Supabase account. Provide step-by-step installation instructions covering dependency installation, environment configuration, database setup, sample data seeding, and Python routing engine setup. Include running instructions for both API and mobile app development servers. Address platform-specific considerations like Google Maps API key setup for Android and Expo dev client requirements. Make content accessible to beginners while ensuring all technical details are covered.

wiki_overview.content:
# TransitGuide — Project Analysis ## 1. Project Introduction **TransitGuide** is a step-by-step navigation application designed for first-time long-distance public transport commuters in South Africa. The app transforms an uncertain trip into a predictable one by answering four critical questions before departure: - Which ranks (bus terminals/taxi stands) to visit and where to change vehicles - What each leg costs and how much cash to carry - What each transfer point looks like with visual landmarks - Which route is cheapest, fastest, easiest, or safest at the current time ### Core Goals - **Predictability**: Eliminate uncertainty for first-time commuters - **Practicality**: Provide real-world guidance including cash requirements and visual landmarks - **Accessibility**: Support multiple transport modes (long-distance taxis, mini-buses, local buses, metro trains) - **Multi-criteria routing**: Offer different route options based on user priorities ### Target Audience First-time long-distance public transport users who need detailed, practical guidance beyond simple turn-by-turn directions. ## 2. Technical Architecture The project follows a modern monorepo architecture using npm workspaces, separating concerns across mobile app, API service, shared types, and specialized services. ```mermaid graph TD A[Mobile App
Expo/React Native] --> B[REST API
Express.js] B --> C[(Supabase
PostgreSQL + PostGIS)] B --> D[Python Routing Engine
NetworkX Graph Search] E[Shared Types
@hackathon26/shared] --> A E --> B F[Seed Data
Johannesburg → Mbombela] --> C G[Database Migrations
PostGIS Schema] --> C ``` ### Component Breakdown **Frontend Layer** (`apps/mobile`): - Expo Router-based React Native application - Placeholder home screen demonstrating workspace integration - Maps integration via react-native-maps **API Layer** (`services/api`): - Express.js REST API with TypeScript - Request validation using Zod schemas - Supabase client integration - Health check endpoint and route planning stub **Domain Layer** (`packages/shared`): - Types-only package defining core domain concepts - Shared between mobile app and API for type safety - Defines Rank, Leg, RouteOption, and related entities **Data Layer** (`supabase/migrations`): - PostgreSQL with PostGIS extension - Spatial queries for nearest rank calculations - Row-level security policies **Routing Engine** (`services/routing`): - Python-based graph search engine (not yet integrated) - Multi-objective optimization (cheapest/fastest/easiest/safest) ### Design Patterns - **Monorepo Pattern**: Single repository with npm workspaces for unified dependency management - **Types-Only Package**: Shared domain types without runtime dependencies - **Repository Pattern**: API as single backend abstraction over data sources - **Schema Validation**: Zod for request/response validation - **Migration Management**: Database schema evolution through SQL migrations ## 3. Key Implementation ### Main Entry Points **Mobile Application Entry** (`apps/mobile/src/app/_layout.tsx`): - Root navigator setup using Expo Router's Stack navigation - Status bar configuration and initial screen mounting **API Server Entry** (`services/api/src/index.ts`): - Express server initialization with CORS and JSON parsing - Environment configuration loading - Health check and route planning endpoints - Error handling middleware ### Core Modules **Domain Model** (`packages/shared/src/index.ts`): - TransportMode enum supporting various public transport types - GeoPoint interface for location data - Rank interface representing boarding/alighting points - Leg interface for individual journey segments - RouteOption interface for complete journey plans - FareBreakdown interface for cost transparency **Database Schema** (`supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql`): - PostGIS-enabled spatial database design - Ranks table with geographic locations and facility information - Legs table with directed edges and fare data - Fare snapshots table for historical pricing - Custom `ranks_within()` function for proximity searches ### Configuration Approach **Workspace Configuration** (`package.json`): - Monorepo root managing all packages and services - Node.js version enforcement (20+) - Script aliases for common development tasks - React version overrides to prevent duplicate instances **Service Configuration** (`services/api/package.json`): - ES module support for modern JavaScript features - Development tooling with tsx for hot reloading - Type checking and linting setup ### External Dependencies **Mobile Dependencies** (`apps/mobile/package.json`): - Expo SDK 57 for cross-platform mobile development - React Native 0.86.3 for native platform access - react-native-maps for mapping functionality - expo-router for file-based routing **API Dependencies** (`services/api/package.json`): - Express 5.x for web server framework - @supabase/supabase-js for database client - Zod for runtime type validation - dotenv for environment variable management ### Integration Points **Type Sharing** (`packages/shared/package.json`): - Types-only export configuration - Workspace dependency resolution - TypeScript compilation settings **Environment Setup**: - Supabase credentials for database access - Google Maps API key for Android mapping - Environment-specific configuration files ```mermaid flowchart TD A[User Input] --> B[Mobile App UI] B --> C[API Request] C --> D[Request Validation] D --> E[Route Planning Logic] E --> F[Database Query] F --> G[Graph Search] G --> H[Response Assembly] H --> I[Mobile Display] ``` ## 4. Key Features ### Functionality Overview **Current Implementation**: - ✅ Workspace setup and dependency management - ✅ Domain type definitions and sharing - ✅ Basic API structure with health checks - ✅ Database schema with spatial capabilities - ✅ Mobile app skeleton with navigation **Planned Features**: - 🔄 Complete route planning algorithm - 🔄 Real-time fare calculation and breakdowns - 🔄 Interactive map display with route visualization - 🔄 User authentication and profile management - 🔄 Historical fare tracking and alerts ### Implementation Highlights **Spatial Database Design** (`supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql`): - PostGIS extension for geographic calculations - Efficient nearest-neighbor queries for rank discovery - Spatial indexing for performance optimization **Type Safety Strategy** (`packages/shared/src/index.ts`): - Comprehensive domain model with TypeScript interfaces - Runtime validation schemas mirroring domain types - Cross-platform type consistency between mobile and API **Development Experience** (`package.json`): - Unified workspace commands for multi-service development - Hot reloading for both API and mobile applications - Type checking across all packages simultaneously ### Feature Architecture ```mermaid stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> Idle Idle --> JourneyPlanning: User enters origin/destination JourneyPlanning --> RouteOptions: API returns routes RouteOptions --> RouteSelection: User selects option RouteSelection --> Navigation: Start step-by-step guidance Navigation --> Complete: Journey finished RouteOptions --> Idle: Cancel Navigation --> Idle: Cancel ``` **Multi-Criteria Routing System**: - Cheapest: Optimizes for minimum fare cost - Fastest: Minimizes total travel time - Easiest: Reduces transfer complexity - Safest: Prioritizes reliable transport modes **Cash Flow Management**: - Separate tracking of total fares vs. actual cash needed - Recognition that operators rarely have change - Practical advice for cash preparation Sources: - [README.md](README.md) - [ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [package.json](package.json) - [mobile package.json](apps/mobile/package.json) - [api package.json](services/api/package.json) - [shared package.json](packages/shared/package.json) - [domain types](packages/shared/src/index.ts) - [API entry](services/api/src/index.ts) - [mobile layout](apps/mobile/src\app\_layout.tsx) - [mobile home](apps/mobile/src\app\index.tsx) - [database schema](supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql)
